# komodo_docker_registry_account (Resource)

Manages a Komodo docker registry account (credentials for accessing private image registries).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Registry domain without protocol (e.g. 'registry.hub.docker.com', 'ghcr.io'). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Personal access token or password for the registry account. Sensitive.
- `username` (String) Registry account username. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the docker registry account.
